<!-- Keep this short. A reviewer should know what they are looking at in under
     30 seconds. Detail belongs in the diff, the issue, or docs/ — not here.
     Delete each comment as you fill its section in, and delete any section
     that does not apply. -->

## What changed

<!-- Two to four sentences of prose, answering:
       what  — what this changes, in plain terms
       why   — the problem it solves, or the issue it closes
       how   — the approach, only if the diff does not make it obvious

     Sentences, not a bullet dump of every file you touched. If you genuinely
     need a list, cap it at five bullets of one line each. -->

## Proof

<!-- UI: before/after screenshots or a short video from the local stack.
     Backend: test output or command output showing the new behavior. -->

## How I verified

<!-- Commands you ran and their results — paste the output, don't just claim a
     pass. Claim only checks that actually ran; say what you did not test. -->

## Agent context

<!-- Tool, model, and how much of the change the agent wrote. -->

## Explainer

<!-- Required over 500 changed lines or 10 files (lockfiles and generated code
     don't count): what changed, why, and how the pieces connect. -->
